verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Incident Workflows triggered by incidents through "if-this-then-that" triggers, which is event-driven automation, not a recurring time-based schedule. On-call schedules (docs-12) set human coverage rather than jobs. "Schedule a Scribe Agent" (docs-63) is a one-off action tied to an incident call, not a recurring schedule. No documented capability lets a user schedule recurring jobs or workflows, so these items are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
